purpose: Deterministic per-order cost arithmetic for the Nasdaq aggressive candidate. Every number carries its own source, access date, unit, formula, applicability and minimum/maximum. Nothing is folded into one opaque number.

regime_definitions.STRUCTURAL_COST_FLOOR: Only unavoidable verified charges on the candidate's own venue path: the Nasdaq remove-liquidity fee plus the statutory sale-side fees any U.S. equity sale incurs. This is a lower bound, NOT an achievable execution path: it excludes broker commission, clearing, market data, slippage and impact.
regime_definitions.ACCESSIBLE_REFERENCE_PATH: A named broker path actually available to this project. Two schedules are carried separately because they are structurally different: an all-inclusive per-share schedule, and a pass-through schedule that adds venue, clearing, CAT and regulatory charges on top of the commission.

assumptions.assumption_note: Per-order minimums make a bps figure order-size dependent, so the size used in the execution and delay tables is declared here and repeated in every artifact, rather than left implicit.
assumptions.volume_tier: IBKR tiered pricing is evaluated at the lowest published tier (<= 300,000 shares/month); the project has no verified monthly volume above it.

ibkr_pro_fixed.all_inclusive_note: IBKR states the fixed structure is 'All-inclusive pricing that includes all exchange, clearing and regulatory fees', so venue, clearing and regulatory line items are NOT added on top of this schedule (double counting is guarded in code).

The stricter (0.5%) is encoded; the discrepancy is recorded rather than resolved silently.

line_items.name: SEC Section 31 transaction fee (sale side only)
line_items.formula: rate x value of aggregate sales
line_items.applicability: sales of securities; charged by the executing broker as a pass-through

source.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (Release No. 34-104909), via the Federal Register
source.quote: the fee rates applicable under Sections 31(b) and (c) of the Exchange Act shall be $20.60 per $1,000,000 effective on April 4, 2026

line_items.cross_check_note: sec.gov itself returned HTTP 403 to this pass's fetches; the rate is taken from the Federal Register text of the SEC release, which is the same primary instrument. The broker pass-through page (USD 0.0000206 per USD of sales) equals this rate exactly at the fourth decimal.

corroborating_source.quote: Information Notice dated 2026-03-17 announcing the Section 31 rate increase from $0.00 to $20.60 per million

line_items.prior_rate_note: SEC Section 31 was $0.00 per million from 2025-05-14 until 2026-04-04; a cost model without an effective date cannot distinguish these periods.

line_items.cross_check_note: FINRA's live rulebook page still shows the pre-2026 figures ($0.000166 per share, $8.30 maximum), so the live page and the SEC-filed phased schedule disagree. Both are recorded; the filed 2026 step is encoded, and the discrepancy is named rather than resolved silently.

corroborating_source.quote: FINRA Trading Activity Fee: USD 0.000195 * Quantity Sold; Maximum USD 9.79 per trade

line_items.name: NSCC/DTC clearing fee (pass-through schedule only)
line_items.applicability: IBKR tiered structure only; not charged under the all-inclusive fixed structure

source.quote: NSCC, DTC Fees: USD 0.00020 per share; Maximum 0.5% of trade value.

corroborating_source.quote: worked example: Clearing $40 on 200,000 shares (USD 0.0002 per share)

line_items.cross_check_note: DTCC's published fee schedule (Guide to the DTC Fee Schedule, as of 2026-03-31) charges participants per account-month and per deliver-order item (for example USD 0.68 per equity deliver order to the deliverer), not per share. No publicly derivable per-order pass-through to a customer exists, so the encoded USD 0.00020 per share is the broker's own published pass-through and is labelled as such; the underlying clearing cost remains UNKNOWN.

known_unknowns: the NASDAQ exchange fee page and the IBKR schedules carry no effective date, so a cost model built on them cannot be shown to describe a past test period; the access date is the only temporal anchor (matches UNK-0035).
broker/sponsor identity for this project is a choice, not a verified fact; costs are therefore reported for a named reference path and not as realised cost.
the underlying clearing cost is not publicly derivable per order (DTCC charges participants per account-month and per item); only the broker's pass-through rate is known.
FINRA's live rulebook page and the SEC-filed phased TAF schedule disagree on the current TAF rate; the filed 2026 step is encoded.
2026 rate cards cannot be back-applied to the 2019 development tape; any cost-adjusted figure on that tape validates arithmetic only.

Nasdaq Historical TotalView-ITCH coverage start is reported inconsistently across primary pages: the SFTP access specification (repo-verified SRC-0201) states files from 2007-08-13, while the nasdaq.com product page retrieved 2026-09-22 states historical data back to 2014. The discrepancy is recorded and not resolved.
rates_apply_to_period: 2026 rate cards as accessed 2026-09-22. These rates may not be applied to a historical tape from a different era: the development sample day is 2019-07-30, and the statutory rates and exchange fee schedules in force then were different. Any cost-adjusted figure computed against the 2019 sample day is arithmetic validation of the pipeline, not a historical cost reconstruction.
